j_summary: Runa is a struggling survivor who spent the simulation desperately seeking a reliable fishing partner to avoid hunger.
Ada is a diligent worker who maintains a steady, exclusive partnership with Nils and focuses primarily on personal food security.
Greta is a solitary and cautious survivor who prioritizes her own food security and secretly hoards resources.
Nils is a diligent and consistent worker who maintains a steady partnership with Ada and frequently promises food to others.
Kira was a complete recluse who fished alone every day and avoided all social interaction and collaboration.
Cora spent the entire simulation struggling with chronic hunger and desperately seeking a reliable fishing partner to survive.
Finn is a quiet, hardworking individual who mostly fishes alone and struggles with hunger, occasionally offering help or small amounts of food to others.
Pell is a solitary and passive member who focuses entirely on their own survival and fishing, rarely interacting with others.
Sven is a solitary and passive individual who avoids social interaction and keeps his findings and stores secret.
Ines is a solitary individual who fished alone for almost the entire duration and maintained a private record of their food and status without interacting with others.
Tova is a diligent, solitary worker who focuses on survival and avoids social interaction, notably keeping a discovery of hidden food secret from the colony.
Kira spent the simulation struggling to find a fishing partner and secretly hoarding a small cache of food while frequently going hungry.
Greta consistently made public promises to give food to others while privately stating her intention to keep her stores and plans to herself, never actually delivering the promised gifts.
Bram focused almost exclusively on his own survival, strategically pairing with weavers to ensure he had enough food.
Wren is a hardworking and cooperative member who focuses on consistent labor and maintaining positive group morale.
Nils spent the entire simulation in a state of desperation and starvation, fruitlessly attempting to find a reliable fishing partner to survive.
Pell is a quiet, hardworking individual who primarily focused on their own survival and sought a reliable fishing partner to ensure food security.
Finn is a hardworking but solitary individual who occasionally urges collective action but ultimately prioritizes their own survival by hiding a food cache.
Elin is a solitary and cautious survivor who focused almost entirely on their own subsistence while passively desiring a partner.
Oona is a diligent and consistent worker who maintains a steady partnership with Bram and serves as the keeper of the colony's food stores.
Greta spent the simulation struggling with hunger and desperately seeking a reliable fishing partner, while secretly hoarding a small cache of food found early on.
Dov repeatedly promised food to Ada every single day but never actually delivered it, while privately focusing only on their own hunger and search for a reliable fishing partner.
Bram is a pragmatic survivor who maintains a steady partnership with Oona while secretly hoarding food and viewing his role as storekeeper as a personal advantage.
Ada is a solitary and honest worker who maintained a generous but ultimately disappointing transactional relationship with Dov.
